title: readContractSnapshot
responsibility: Reads raw unit contract JSON from worktree, index or Git trees, batches immutable blobs and rejects invalid or duplicate identities without inspecting source.

inputs.name: createContractHistoryReader.root
inputs.description: Existing project directory inside a Git worktree; only its specification/units JSON files and Git contract metadata are read.

outputs.name: createContractHistoryReader
outputs.description: Git-bound reader with per-invocation immutable blob and parsed-JSON caches plus at most two cached commit snapshots. Worktree and index are always read afresh.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Non-worktree roots, malformed JSON, missing ids, duplicate ids or uids, unresolved index stages and malformed blob responses are rejected.

errors.name: Git command or filesystem read failure
errors.description: GitAdapter Error messages retain git arguments and stderr. Filesystem errors such as ENOENT or EACCES propagate; symlink contracts are excluded and a symlink unit directory is rejected.
